jobs.title: Data Analyst, Sr. - Fully Remote
jobs.description:
About the Company

Wing develops and operates drone delivery services designed to make last-mile logistics safer, faster, and more sustainable. Its highly automated aircraft deliver small packages from businesses to homes in minutes. Wing designs, builds, and operates its own aircraft, with services available on two continents. Its technology integrates with existing delivery and logistics networks to support businesses of different sizes. Wing is part of Alphabet, Google's parent company, and aims to make drone delivery the preferred means of delivery worldwide.

About the Role

Wing is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join its Analytics team. The position is based in Palo Alto, California, or remotely within the United States.

This role focuses on using data and analytical modeling to help the business make informed strategic decisions. The Senior Data Analyst will work through complex and sometimes ambiguous business questions, identify the right data sources, evaluate potential tradeoffs, and quantify the impact of different scenarios. The position also involves communicating findings clearly to stakeholders and leadership, turning detailed analysis into practical recommendations that support business priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and meaningful business insights.
Identify appropriate data sources to address ambiguous business questions and ensure analytical findings are accurate and actionable.
Design and build robust models to evaluate tradeoffs and quantify the potential impact of business decisions.
Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity testing to assess different outcomes and support strategic planning.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.
Develop dashboards, automated workflows, and self-service analytics where applicable to make insights accessible and useful.
Partner with business stakeholders to define ambiguous problems and translate them into clear, well-structured analytical questions.
Communicate complex analyses in a way that helps stakeholders understand the findings and make informed decisions.

Required Qualifications

3–6+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business analytics, consulting, or strategic data roles.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative field, such as data analytics or mathematics.
Strong experience in data analysis, modeling, and applied analytics using SQL, Excel, Python, or similar tools.
Demonstrated ability to address complex, ambiguous business problems and develop actionable solutions.
Experience building scenario models, forecasts, or tradeoff analyses to guide business decisions.
Strong communication and analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to present complex findings clearly and with a focus on decisions.
Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive meaningful business impact.
Experience partnering with leadership and influencing decisions across multiple functions.

Salary & Benefits

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $128,000–$170,000 USD, plus bonus, equity, and benefits. Wing determines salary ranges based on the role, level, and work location. The recruiter can provide details about the applicable salary range for the candidate’s location during the hiring process.

Location and Work Arrangement

The role is based in Palo Alto, California, or can be performed remotely within the United States.

Equal Opportunity / EEO

Wing is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable national, state, and local laws concerning nondiscrimination and equal employment opportunity. Employment decisions are based solely on merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence.

Wing does not discriminate against employees or applicants on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, including breastfeeding, or any other status protected by law.

Candidates who require an accommodation during the interview process because of a disability or special need may submit a request through Wing’s Candidate Accommodations Request Form.

jobs.title: Python ML Engineer - Work From Home
jobs.description:
About the Company

Kforce is a staffing and solutions firm connecting organizations with skilled professionals. For this position, Kforce is recruiting on behalf of a client building an enterprise-scale multilingual translation platform.

About the Role

Kforce is seeking a remote Python Machine Learning Engineer to help develop a multilingual translation platform using traditional natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and modern large language models (LLMs).

The role focuses on building translation solutions that support real-time and batch processing, incorporate specialized terminology, and serve multiple digital experiences through a reusable backend service. You will work with technical and business stakeholders to evaluate performance, solve translation challenges, and improve the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Build multilingual and machine translation solutions using Python
Develop and evaluate translation approaches using traditional NLP, machine learning, and LLMs
Support real-time and batch translation use cases
Incorporate custom terminology and domain-specific glossaries into translation outputs
Help develop a reusable backend translation service for multiple digital experiences
Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to assess and improve translation solutions

Required Qualifications

4–5+ years of relevant machine learning or NLP engineering experience
Strong hands-on Python programming skills
Direct experience with machine translation, multilingual NLP, or language translation systems
Strong foundation in traditional natural language processing
Experience working with LLMs or generative AI
Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to real-time translation systems is highly preferred

Salary & Benefits

The pay range is determined based on the compensation Kforce reasonably expects to offer for the position. Actual pay may vary depending on education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, location, performance, union contract requirements, and business needs. The range may be modified in the future.

Eligible employees may receive medical, dental, and vision insurance, health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), a 401(k) plan, and life, disability, and accidental death and dismemberment (ADD) insurance.

Salaried employees receive paid time off. Hourly employees are not eligible for paid time off unless required by law. Hourly employees working on Service Contract Act projects are eligible for paid sick leave.

This position is not eligible for bonuses, incentives, or commissions. Compensation is subject to applicable earning, vesting, and payment conditions and may be modified in accordance with the law.

Equal Opportunity / EEO

Kforce is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Recruitment Communications

By applying, candidates agree to receive calls, AI-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Kforce, its affiliates, and service providers. Message frequency may vary, and message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not responsible for delayed or undelivered messages. Candidates may opt out of text communications by using keywords such as STOP.

jobs.description:
logispacerealty
is looking for a Data Analyst
to join its team.

Data Analyst | Remote (United States) | Full-time

We are seeking an organized, motivated professional to investigate data quality and explain important changes in performance. The role emphasizes practical reporting, data accuracy, and decision-support analysis. You will collaborate remotely, document your work, and raise questions when information is unclear.

Key Responsibilities

Present practical findings with appropriate charts and tables.
Compare results against baseline values and flag material differences.
Clean and validate data before it is used in dashboards or reports.
Use basic SQL queries or comparable tools to answer specific business questions.
Work with stakeholders to clarify definitions and reporting expectations.
Prepare simple trend comparisons and periodic performance summaries.
Explain key observations and limitations in clear, accessible language.

Qualifications

Practical experience with Excel or another spreadsheet application.
Careful, logical approach to investigating inconsistencies.
Comfort collaborating with teammates in a remote environment.
Comfort interpreting charts, tables, and basic performance metrics.
Organized documentation and version-control habits.

Experience from related roles, internships, or individual projects can be useful preparation.

Work arrangement:
Remote within the United States. Employment type:
Full-time. Experience level:
Associate.
